description: This file defines a custom report class for generating product price list reports in XML format within an OpenERP (Odoo) module, including methods for assembling XML data with product and pricing details.

classes.name: report_custom
classes.description: A custom report class for generating product pricelist XML reports, inheriting from report_rml.

methods.name: create_xml
methods.description: Generates an XML report of product prices based on provided data, including product categories, pricing, and date information.
